title: dopemux-route-ledger receipt
$comment: One JSON object per line of <receiptDir>/<sessionId>.jsonl (rolled segments: <sessionId>.<n>.jsonl, n from 1, after maxReceiptsPerFile receipts or at about 3.5 MB). seq runs from 0 per session and continues after a hot reload. recorded_at is RFC 3339 UTC from $.clock.now(); started_at and ended_at of an advisor_call are $.clock.now() epoch milliseconds exactly as the engine gave them. agent_id is the loop the event belongs to (null = main loop); on an agent_request it is the CALLING loop, and spawned_agent_id (joined from agent.spawn by tool_use_id alone, null until it fires) is the loop it started. BINDING FIELDS: agent_request and step_observed carry binding_fields, the shape a supervisor merges into a GEC v2 ExecutionBinding (schemas/governed_execution/execution_binding.v2.schema.json): selection.runner, selection.model, selection.effort and the top-level effort_requested, effort_observed, response_claimed_model, provider_attested_model and independence_class map onto the same-named ExecutionBinding keys. A receipt is NOT a valid ExecutionBinding: that schema has about 23 required keys and the mod knows these six; the supervisor supplies the rest and runs `ct bind-record`; the mod never does. selection.model is the requested alias (agent_request) or the model the engine resolved for the step (step_observed), else UNKNOWN. response_claimed_model is the API-reported usage.model of the step; it is what the response claimed, not provider attestation, so provider_attested_model stays UNKNOWN. The API never reports effort, so effort_observed is always UNKNOWN; independence_class is the supervisor's. match (step_observed) is true when the observed model equals the requested one (a trailing -YYYYMMDD ignored, a bare family alias matching its family), false when it differs, null when either side is unknown. advisor_call records a server-side advisor call the mod can count and cannot block; it is keyed by the server-tool-use id and counted once. No prompt, file content or tool output is ever recorded; description is the empty string unless the recordDescription option is on (default off), and then it is the Agent call's short label cut to 80 characters. An empty effort or advisor id is never recorded: an empty effort is UNKNOWN in binding_fields and null in requested_effort, and an advisor use with an empty id is skipped.
